title.narrative: Emergency WASH Assistance to newly displaced populations in Lushagala site, Goma

description.narrative: Project Objective : To Contribute in providing emergency sanitation infrastructure to newly displaced conflict affected populations in Lushagala site.

The project will support a total of 2,000 households, who will benefit from 200 newly constructed emergency latrines and 1,000 WASH kits for most vulnerable households in the blocks around the new latrines. According to IOM/CCCM for Lushagala site, the average household size is 5 people. In addition, according to the DRC's Humanitarian Response Plan 2024, the breakdown is 27% for boys, 27% for girls, 22% for men and 24% for women and 15% for people living with disabilities. The calculations of the population reached takes into account the above indications. Hence, the project will reach 10,000 persons (2,000 households) in total through the construction of emergency latrines and distribution of WASH kits. The most vulnerable 1000 households among the newly displaced people living in the blocks with the latrines to be constructed will be targeted for the WASH kits distribution.

WHH, together with Bon Dieu dans la Rue (BDRint), received funding from StartFund to scale up the currently ongoing emergency response in the sector of WASH in Lushagala site, outside of Goma. Through the StartFund funding, 200 new emergency latrine stalls (20 latrines blocks) will be constructed for newly displaced people in Lushagala site. In addition, 1000 WASH kits, including menstrual hygiene kits, will be distributed to 1000 newly displaced and extremely vulnerable households around the new latrines.
